description: This file implements a text-based Word Guess game in Go, including game state management, user interaction, and display styling.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Represents the state of a word guessing game, including the word, guessed letters, and game status.

methods.name: NewGame
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Word Guess game with a random word from the list.

methods.name: GuessLetter
methods.description: Processes a guessed letter, updates game state, and checks for win/lose conditions.

methods.name: GetRemainingLetters
methods.description: Returns a string of alphabet letters that have not yet been guessed.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current game state, including display styling.

methods.name: PlayGame
methods.description: Starts an interactive game session, handling user input and game flow.
